runtime: Windows .NET Framework >=4.8; no GUI, extra runtime DLL, Python, SDK or network required
supported_read: canonical flat raw NOA with zero attributes and encoding type
supported_write: new flat raw NOA with explicit --raw
limitations: archives below 2 GiB with conservative creation index allowance
NOA timestamps, attributes and extra metadata are not preserved
NOA compression, encryption and original-form metadata roundtrip are unsupported
changes: Retain and build the pinned upstream NS2.cs, NOA.cs, Utils.cs and ArcEncoding.cs unchanged.
Replace GUI configuration, progress logging and CString helper with Headless.cs.
Add structural preflight, canonical CP932 byte checks, path validation before and after dot normalization, link/reparse rejection, staged output publication and nonzero errors.
verification: NS2/NOA CLI roundtrips with Japanese names and empty files; independent GARbro extraction; standalone identical bundles; refusal of overwrite, malformed bounds, noncanonical CP932 bytes, unsafe paths, nested NOA input and parent/cancelled links. No game runtime validation.
